verdict.rationale: Fathom documents user-level API keys generated in User Settings → API Access. Each key simply inherits the user's own meeting visibility; an Admin key can read everything shared once view permissions are granted. Nothing in the evidence describes per-key scopes, read-only keys, resource restrictions, or other least-privilege credential options. OAuth for public apps and MCP authentication are mentioned, but no scopes are documented for either, so they do not count toward this story.
